replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. My low neuroticism score (23) means I stay calm under pressure. I’ve used math for practical tasks like budgeting and coding, so it feels manageable. If I’m stuck, I break problems into smaller steps—no panic!

If it’s positive, two real roots; zero, one real root; negative, complex roots. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b²-4ac)] / (2a). Practice with numbers to get comfortable!

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding directions (principal components) that capture the most variance. First, standardize your data. Then, compute the covariance matrix and its eigenvectors. The eigenvectors give the new axes, and eigenvalues show variance explained.
